Flow.description:
This Flow evaluates a student’s IEP (Individualized Education Program) data to determine their current status in the IEP review and approval process. It replicates the existing Zoho logic that drives the “IEP Status” field, using multiple layers of conditional logic to assess whether the IEP process is complete or if further review, family contact, or administrative action is required. The Flow considers key factors such as: Student Type and Enrollment Status (e.g., Returning, Canceled, Rescinded) Uploaded IEP status and SESIS record alignment Network and Principal IEP approval outcomes Family decisions regarding IEP placement Completion of all required IEP program and service fields (e.g., SETSS, OT, PT, Counseling, Transportation, etc.) Existence of 504 plans and accommodations
Flow Designer: Elevation Solutions

formulas.description: Returns TRUE when the student’s IEP Classification is “N/A”, the Has 504 Plan checkbox is selected (TRUE), and the 504 Accommodations field contains text. This indicates the student does not have an active IEP but has a valid and documented 504 Plan.
formulas.name: fx504PlanComplete

formulas.description: Returns TRUE when the IEP record has incomplete required data, missing SESIS updates, or a “Needs Review” Network IEP Approval with no active revisions. Used by the Decision element to set IEP Status = “StAT needs to review IEP”.
formulas.name: fxIEPNeedsReview

formulas.description: Returns TRUE when all required IEP fields, services, and approvals meet the conditions for “IEP Process Complete.”
formulas.name: fxIEPProcessComplete

formulas.description:
Checks if Uploaded_IEP__c is exactly one of the two values from your picklist that represent “no valid IEP.”
Also confirms that Is_there_an_IEP_on_SESIS__c ≠ Yes.
Returns TRUE only when both are met — meaning, “no valid upload and no SESIS IEP.”
formulas.name: fxInvalidIEPUpload
